marketing_description: The Leviton SmartlockPro GFCI Outlet, part number R12-AGTR1-0KW, is a 125 V, 15 A, 60 Hz rated device with 2 poles and 3 wires, featuring a self-grounding and NEMA 5-15R configuration. This white outlet includes tamper-resistant shutters to prevent unwanted object insertion and auto-monitoring/self-test functionality for safety. An audible trip alarm indicator provides notification in the event of a trip.
